description: This file defines interfaces for browser control and event notifications within the WPEFramework, including classes for managing URLs, visibility, cookies, security, scripting, and resources.

classes.name: IBrowser
classes.description: Interface for direct browser manipulation, including URL setting, FPS retrieval, and visibility control.

classes.name: IWebBrowser
classes.description: Extended interface for web browser with event notifications, URL management, visibility, user agent, cookies, and garbage collection.

classes.name: IBrowserResources
classes.description: Interface for managing browser resources such as headers, user scripts, and style sheets.

classes.name: IBrowserSecurity
classes.description: Interface for managing security settings like security profile and mixed content policy.

classes.name: IBrowserScripting
classes.description: Interface for executing JavaScript and managing user scripts.

classes.name: IBrowserCookieJar
classes.description: Interface for managing browser cookies, including change notifications.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for browser events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink for browser events.

methods.name: SetURL
methods.description: Sets the URL displayed in the browser.

methods.name: GetURL
methods.description: Retrieves the current URL from the browser.

methods.name: GetFPS
methods.description: Retrieves the current framerate of the browser rendering.

methods.name: Hide
methods.description: Sets the visibility state of the browser.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Notification callback when page load is finished.

methods.name: LoadFailed
methods.description: Notification callback when page load fails.

methods.name: URLChange
methods.description: Notification callback for URL changes.

methods.name: VisibilityChange
methods.description: Notification callback for visibility changes.

methods.name: PageClosure
methods.description: Notification callback when page requests to close.

methods.name: BridgeQuery
methods.description: Handles bridge query messages.

methods.name: HeaderList
methods.description: Gets or sets HTTP headers for requests.

methods.name: UserAgent
methods.description: Gets or sets the UserAgent string.

methods.name: LocalStorageEnabled
methods.description: Gets or sets local storage availability.

methods.name: HTTPCookieAcceptPolicy
methods.description: Gets or sets HTTP cookie accept policy.

methods.name: BridgeReply
methods.description: Sends a response to legacy $badger.

methods.name: BridgeEvent
methods.description: Sends a legacy $badger event.

methods.name: CollectGarbage
methods.description: Initiates garbage collection.

methods.name: Headers
methods.description: Gets headers to send on requests.

methods.name: UserScripts
methods.description: Gets or sets user scripts.

methods.name: UserStyleSheets
methods.description: Gets or sets user style sheets.

methods.name: SecurityProfile
methods.description: Gets or sets security profile for secure connections.

methods.name: MixedContentPolicy
methods.description: Gets or sets mixed content policy.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript in the main frame.

methods.name: AddUserScript
methods.description: Adds a user script to be executed at document start.

methods.name: RemoveAllUserScripts
methods.description: Removes all user scripts.

methods.name: CookieJar
methods.description: Gets or sets cookies in the cookie jar.

methods.name: CookieJarChanged
methods.description: Notification when cookies are added, removed, or modified.
